confidence_model: RAW research-grade registry data compiled by GEM (their sourcing notes are preserved per feature). HYPOTHESES (gate-locked): (1) mine boundaries x FIRMS/S1/S2 = mine-activity proxies; (2) Parent Company / ParentEntityIDs = the equity join spine into the entity graph (GEOT ownership tracker is the richer follow-up); (3) pipeline FID/status by parent = capex-cycle features; (4) finance-tracker financier networks. Nothing traded until ladder gates; geometry joins need gate-1 vs known mine activity first. PART-2 ADDITIONS: GEOT's SEC-CIK/LEI/PermID crosswalk is the DIRECT equity join (EDGAR pipeline <-> GEM entities); GMET plumes are dated satellite methane events (joinable to mines/fields by coordinates); LNG carriers join the AIS archive on IMO; coal-finance financier networks.
geo_fields: coal mine bbox/centroid + full feature geometry (gz); pipelines have NO coordinates in this variant (start/end location TEXT only)
entity_key: GEM Mine ID / ProjectID+SegmentName / GEM Terminal ID + Train + Financier row
cadence: GEM releases ~2x/year per tracker; session-run re-ingest on each delivery
